description: This file defines the `ExecAllowlistMatcher` enum with static methods to match executable paths against an allowlist pattern, providing functionality for pattern validation, normalization, and regex-based matching.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a single executable resolution against a list of allowlist entries, returning the first matching entry or nil.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Matches multiple command resolutions against allowlist entries, returning all matching entries.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a target string matches a pattern using regular expressions.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by replacing backslashes with forward slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Generates a NSRegularExpression object from a pattern string, converting wildcards into regex syntax.
